reviews.comment: Top of the class in Data Structures; helps classmates during labs.
Strong project work, sometimes submits assignments a day late.
Nominated for the department scholarship.
Excellent presentation in the Operating Systems seminar.
Attendance dropped below 70% this month; missed two internal tests.
Parents informed about attendance; a family health issue was shared in confidence.
Still settling into first year; quiet in class but scores well in written tests.
Joined the robotics club and contributed to the line-follower build.
Final-year project is on schedule but the report needs better structure.
Received an internship offer from a manufacturing firm.
Disciplinary warning for a lab safety violation; no further action needed.
Won the inter-college coding contest; very consistent in assignments.
Mentors two first-year students voluntarily.
Good grasp of circuit theory but the practical record is often incomplete.
Leads the site-survey group; accurate and punctual.
Outstanding structural design submission, best in the batch.
Solid placement preparation; cleared the first round at two companies.
Capstone demo had gaps in testing; asked to resubmit.
Counselling session held for placement anxiety; follow-up planned in November.
Published a short paper on antenna design with the faculty guide.
Reliable lab partner and well prepared for viva.
Struggling with engineering drawing; has been late to several classes.
Attending extra tutorial sessions; small improvement in the latest quiz.
Fee payment delayed due to financial hardship; scholarship application in progress.
